visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A ginger and white cat is seen lying in a round beige pet bed under a low-hanging shelf or cabinet. A person's hand reaches in and attempts to pet the cat's belly. The cat looks alert and somewhat defensive, with its ears slightly tensed. The lighting is warm and indoor. (2) The cat stands up and jumps away from the hand, moving from the bed onto a white plastic storage box. It looks back towards the hand with its mouth slightly open, appearing annoyed. The hand continues to follow its movement. (3) The scene shifts to a different context where the cat is lying on its back on a cardboard scratching pad. A hand with a gold bracelet gently rubs the cat's belly in a rhythmic motion. The cat is completely relaxed, with its eyes partially closed and its paws curled in. (4) The cat is back in a bed-like box. A finger reaches out to touch the soft fur between its paw pads. The cat remains very calm and opens its mouth in a wide, slow yawn, showing its tongue and teeth before settling back into a sleepy state while the hand continues to touch its paw.
